head: working-tree
subject: xDS system root certs and correct CertificateValidationContext field numbers
change: CertificateValidationContext decoding now uses the Envoy v3 field numbers: 2 verify_certificate_hash, 3 verify_certificate_spki, 6 require_signed_certificate_timestamp (BoolValue), 7 crl, 8 allow_expired_certificate, 9 match_subject_alt_names, 10 trust_chain_verification, 17 system_root_certs. Earlier code read SAN matchers from field 2 and pins from fields 4/5, which matched the project's own fixtures but not the real Envoy/gRPC wire format. tls_material now loads the platform trust store via Bundle.rescan when system_root_certs is set or when identity/hash verification is requested without an inline CA, matching gRPC's default-root behavior. The runtime SDS resolution copies system_root_certs into the cluster override.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/sds/secret_tests.zig covers system-root markers, hash-only validation, empty-validation rejection and SPKI/hash decoding with the corrected fields. src/grpc/xds/cds/tests.zig covers inline system roots with SAN matchers, empty-validation rejection and allow_expired rejection. src/grpc/xds/tls_material.zig now runs in the aggregator and covers SAN matchers, certificate hash pins, SPKI pins, hash-only system-root loading and system-root loading. src/grpc/xds/runtime/sds_tests.zig covers resolving an SDS system-root validation secret end to end.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='gRPC CDS' -Dtest-filter='gRPC LDS' -Dtest-filter='SDS' -Dtest-filter='LRS' -Dtest-filter='xdstp' -Dtest-filter='xDS TLS' --summary all

full_library.notes: Earlier full runs at host load 20-32 failed only the pre-existing WSS/HTTP2 caller-timeout test-isolation flake (its printed stack unwinds through unrelated WebTransport/HTTP3 frames); that test passes in isolation and the WebTransport/DATAGRAM subset passes 862/862 three consecutive times. The final full run passed.

notes: Inline trusted_ca and system_root_certs are both accepted; when both are absent, identity or hash verification falls back to platform roots. require_ocsp_staple is not present in v3 and remains rejected through the unknown-field path only when its wire shape is not recognized. OCSP, CRL, custom validators, provider instances, max_verify_depth and typed SAN matchers remain unsupported.
